business_scope.primary_industry_name: Professional Multilingual Translation and Media Dubbing

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Republic of China Companies Act (公司法), primarily Articles 128–156 (incorporation, share capital, shareholder rights) and Article 387 (registration procedure and competent authority)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) – Agency for Commerce Development (商業發展署), Company Registration Division; online filing via MOEA One-Stop Company Registration Portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Application Form (公司設立登記申請書) together with Articles of Incorporation (公司章程) and capitalization verification report (資本額查核報告書)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under the Taiwan Companies Act; capital must be fully subscribed, remitted into the company's bank account in New Taiwan Dollars, and verified by a certified public accountant (CPA) prior to filing; no escrow account requirement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: The sole incorporator subscribes in full for 1 ordinary share of the Company, paid up in cash. RESOLVED: The registered office is fixed at the address stated in the incorporation application, applicable to all lawful notices. RESOLVED: [Name] is appointed Chairman and Director and [Name] is appointed General Manager, each with authority to sign banking, licensing, and operational agreements. RESOLVED: The Chairman is authorized to execute the incorporation filing with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and to obtain all applicable corporate certificates. RESOLVED: Corporate books shall be maintained in New Taiwan Dollars under generally accepted standards.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Pre-Approval (公司名稱及所營事業預查)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA One-Stop Company Registration Portal (公司名稱預查系統)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name pre-approval application for the proposed English and Chinese company names and stated business scope (ISIC 7490 translation and localization services). Pay the online processing fee and obtain an electronic pre-approval certificate, valid for six months.
required_dossiers: Proposed company English and Chinese names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name is rejected for similarity or ambiguity, file an amended application with alternative names and a written explanatory statement for the registry's examiner; the examination can be re-submitted within the same online session.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Inflow and Capital Verification (外人投資匯入及資本查核)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Investment Commission (投資審議司) and licensed FX bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If not already approved in Stage 1, file or confirm the foreign investment application. Open a local bank account in the company name, remit the subscribed capital from the foreign parent entity in USD or TWD, convert into New Taiwan Dollars, and obtain a bank deposit balance certificate (存款餘額證明) evidencing the paid-up capital.
required_dossiers: Foreign exchange declaration form (若有結售外匯)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or Investment Commission queries the capital remittance, supplement the source-of-funds explanation letter, corporate authorization, and proof of beneficial ownership; pending rectification, the CPA capital verification can be performed after the funds are cleared.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Signing of Articles of Incorporation (訂立公司章程)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notarization by a licensed Taiwan notary or the sole incorporator's execution in writing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Have the sole foreign shareholder (or its Taiwan representative) execute the Articles of Incorporation, specifying the company name, registered office, business scope, authorized capital, director and supervisor structure, and managerial powers. For a single-member WFOE, the Articles may be executed by written resolution of the sole shareholder.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney for Taiwan representative (if applicable)
Shareholder identity or certificate of incorporation of parent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry notes defects in the Articles, revise the text and re-execute; signatures must match the identity documents held on file with MOEA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: CPA Capital Verification Report (資本額查核報告書)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Taiwan Certified Public Accountant (會計師)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed CPA to review the bank deposit certificate, foreign investment approval, and remittance evidence, and to issue a statutory capital verification report attesting that the paid-up capital is fully received and not withdrawn. The report must be dated within 15 days before incorporation filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CPA issues a qualified report due to incomplete remittance evidence, cure by obtaining a supplementary bank statement or an official confirmation letter from the FX bank and re-issue the capital verification report.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to MOEA (公司設立登記申請)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Agency for Commerce Development – Company Registration Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the electronic incorporation application through the MOEA One-Stop portal, attaching the Articles, capital verification report, name approval certificate, lease or proof of registered office, and appointment documents for directors and officers. Pay the statutory registration fee online and retain the payment receipt.
required_dossiers: Registered office proof (lease or title deed with consent)
Directors and supervisor identification and consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA issues an objection or request for supplement, respond through the portal within the statutory cure period (usually 30 days); any rejected item must be corrected with an amended document and re-submitted at no additional filing fee for minor defects.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Company Registration Certificate (公司登記證明)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon successful examination, MOEA approves the incorporation and publishes a registration entry; download and print the electronic Company Registration Certificate. Verify that the English company name, address, capital, and directors are correctly recorded; request a supplementary English certificate copy if needed for banking abroad.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors, file a rectification application with the supporting evidence; if the registration is rejected outright, appeal to MOEA or the administrative court within the applicable time limits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Labour/Healthcare Enrollment (稅籍登記及投保作業)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local National Taxation Bureau (region of the company office) and Bureau of Labour Insurance (勞保局)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete tax registration (營業稅籍登記) with the Local National Taxation Bureau within 15 days of incorporation approval to obtain a Taxpayer Identification Number for profit-enterprise income tax, business tax, and withholding tax. Register for labour insurance, health insurance, and pension contributions for employees; complete workplace safety basic registration.
required_dossiers: Lease or ownership proof of office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax authorities delay activation of the tax registration, submit a follow-up via the online tax clinic or in-person supplementary window; request an issuance of the tax certificate urgently, and if needed escalate through the National Taxation Bureau's complaint line.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – ISIC 7490 (professional translation and localization) is a non-manufacturing service activity; no industrial operating permit is required under Taiwan law.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – no industrial/municipal operating license triggered for multilingual translation and media dubbing service.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Category F / Non-EIA-listed service industry; no Environmental Impact Assessment report required for office-based localization operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, or flue-gas discharge; general business waste must be disposed through authorized municipal waste collection in compliance with the Waste Disposal Act; office noise and lighting must meet local municipal comfort standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not statutorily applicable for a non-industrial office activity; however, the workplace lease must comply with fire safety and building use regulations, fire-extinguisher placement must be checked by the local fire authority, carried out under the Occupational Safety and Health Act for office premises; no structural load inspection is required for ordinary office occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (Tax Administration); operational portal: National Taxation Portal (e-tax portal at etax.nat.gov.tw)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested entity incorporated in Taiwan (e.g., a branch or subsidiary) must complete company registration with the Ministry of Economic Affairs, after which the Taiwan tax authority automatically issues a Business Administration Number (BAN, uniform invoice number). The BAN serves as the VAT registration number. The entity must then register for VAT (Business Tax) with the local National Taxation Bureau, obtain a unified invoice registration, and set up tax filing credentials through the e-tax portal. Non-resident foreign enterprises without a fixed place of business apply for temporary Tax ID numbers via withholding agent registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: TAIWAN CHECK-THE-BOX UNDER INCOME TAX ACT: No general check-the-box regime for entity classification. Hybrid mismatch rules under the Income Tax Act and the Company Act may recharacterize payments or entities where treaty/tax outcomes are inconsistent. Elective application of qualified foreign intermediary rules for withholding, and elective consolidated business tax filing for affiliated companies under the Business Tax Act are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold for VAT registration; any enterprise selling goods or services in Taiwan, or importing goods, must register as a business tax entity. Small-scale businesses (monthly turnover below TWD 80,000 for goods or TWD 40,000 for services) may apply for a reduced rate of 1% subject to approval.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic uniform invoices (eUI) for most VAT-registered businesses. Integration with the MOF e-invoice platform; exporters and B2B service providers must transmit invoice details digitally. Compliance via Turnkey network protocols, JSON/XML APIs, and platform certificates. No real-time fiscal stamping in the EU/CIS sense; filing is periodic with real-time submission of e-invoice data to the national platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under Article 7 of the Business Tax Act to the export of goods, provision of services to foreign enterprises or non-residents where the services are used entirely outside Taiwan, exported services related to goods located outside Taiwan, and sales of goods/services in connection with offshore trade. For multilingual localization services provided to foreign clients, zero-rating is available where the service benefits a foreign recipient; supporting documentation must prove the foreign status of the client and that the service is not used in Taiwan.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (for goods)
Foreign Exchange Settlement Certificate (Inward Remittance Certificate)
Statement certifying the service is used/provided outside Taiwan
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or incorrect zero-rating claims trigger: (i) recovery of unpaid tax, (ii) a fine of up to 15 times the amount of the undercollected tax under the Business Tax Act, (iii) penalty for failure to issue or preserve uniform invoices, and (iv) criminal liability for tax evasion/forgery of documentation under the Tax Evasion and Tax Collection Law, including imprisonment up to 5 years. Retroactive clawback periods apply for up to 7 years for executions and up to 15 years for tax evasion-related penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China, exercising delegated authority from the People's Bank of China (PBOC) over onshore foreign-exchange administration, settlement and sale, and balance-of-payments declaration; PBOC operates the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS) for RMB clearing. The Taiwan leg is subject to the Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) and the Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) at the outward remittance source, with Bank of China Taipei Branch acting as the designated cross-strait RMB clearing bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: RMB is freely convertible for current-account items, including cross-border service-trade receipts and profit remittance, upon genuine-transaction documentary verification; capital-account items remain restricted and flow under a registration-based regime. For this Taiwan-invested CN WFOE: (i) inbound FDI registered capital is admissible under the Foreign Investment Law and the Negative List regime through a bank-mediated SAFE FDI onboarding registration, evidenced by the Business Registration Certificate; (ii) the 2015 voluntary settlement reform (SAFE HuiFa [2015] No. 19) permits the WFOE to convert FDI capital into RMB at its discretion into a settlement-pending account, subject to a negative-use list excluding equity out-investment, securities purchases, unrelated real estate investment, and entrusted loans to third parties; (iii) profit distribution to the Taiwan shareholder is a current-account remittance payable after (a) the annual statutory audit, (b) corporate income tax final settlement, (c) assessment and payment of 10% dividend withholding tax on the non-resident Taiwan shareholder, noting that the 2015 Cross-Strait Anti-Double-Taxation Arrangement is not in force and treaty-reduced rates are not reliably available, (d) a valid board or shareholders' resolution, and (e) electronic tax filing for cross-border payments when the remittance exceeds USD 50,000; (iv) TWD is not freely convertible onshore, and all WFOE contracts and invoices should be denominated in USD or RMB to avoid TWD liquidity friction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Since the SAFE 2012 Reform Announcement and the 2008 Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations, there is no mandatory surrender ratio or forced conversion timeline for service-trade export proceeds. A localization WFOE exporting multilingual translation and dubbing services must: (i) repatriate service-trade receipts into China through its bank-designated current-account foreign-currency operating account within the contractual payment terms; (ii) permit the receiving bank to verify contract-invoice-delivery consistency and to record the receipt in SAFE's cross-border receipts and payments monitoring system; (iii) retain the right to hold the foreign currency balance in USD or to settle voluntarily at its own discretion; and (iv) ensure that receivables are remitted by the invoiced client, or by a formally designated remitter with an instruction letter, to prevent false-trade or false-receipts compliance flags.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Publicity Report (annual return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 30 June covering the immediately preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inclusion in the Abnormal Operations List within 10 working days after the 30 June deadline; administrative fine up to RMB 10,000 under the SAMR Registration Implementing Rules; if uncorrected for 3 consecutive years, escalation to the Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List, triggering multi-department joint credit restrictions, procurement disqualification, and adverse market-entry consequences.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement and Reconciliation (企业所得税汇算清缴)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) — competent in-charge tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May of the year following each taxable year (within 5 months of fiscal year end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% (万分之五) of the underpaid tax from the due date; administrative penalty of 50% to 5 times the underpaid amount for fraudulent or grossly inaccurate filing; downgraded taxpayer credit rating; in egregious cases, tax audit referral and joint disciplinary sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Information Annual Report (外商投资信息报告年度报告)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SAMR in coordination with the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) under the Measures for the Reporting of Foreign Investment Information (2019)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 30 June, filed jointly with the Annual Enterprise Information Publicity Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: SAMR written order to rectify within 20 working days; fine up to RMB 200,000 for refusal to submit; fine of RMB 200,000 to 500,000 for false or misleading disclosures; possible additional listing in the Abnormal Operations List and related credit constraints.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Social Insurance Contribution Base Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau (HRSS) with premium collection administered through the tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during the municipal social insurance contribution-base adjustment window (typically April to July; new base cycle effective 1 July per local circular)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-declaration assessment on the latest known base; daily overdue surcharge of 0.05% on unpaid premiums; administrative fine of between 1 and 3 times the overdue contribution amount under the Social Insurance Law.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Article 208 of the PRC Company Law (2023 revision), every limited liability company must prepare annual financial statements and have them audited by a licensed accounting firm; no revenue or asset threshold exempts the WFOE. A formal statutory audit is in any event required where the entity claims tax loss carry-forwards in the annual CIT settlement, distributes dividends, reduces capital, undergoes share transfer with valuation, or provides audited statements under bank covenants. Small-scale accounting treatment (Small Enterprise Accounting Standards) is available only to qualifying domestic micro and small enterprises; a WFOE serving cross-border clients must apply full Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS/ASBE), substantially converged with IFRS; preference for full CAS given cross-border parent consolidation and ISIC 7490 professional-services revenue recognition.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Interim Administrative Measures on Registration of Beneficial Owners of Market Entities (2021), the WFOE must register ultimate beneficial owner particulars (natural persons holding at least 25% of equity or voting rights or exercising ultimate control, with residence and identification data) with SAMR within 30 days of establishment or any subsequent change. Annual confirmation is effected through the Annual Enterprise Information Publicity Report cycle: prior to each 1 January to 30 June filing window, the compliance officer must reconcile the UBO registry file against the Register of Members and record all share transfers completed in the previous year, updating SAMR within 30 days of each equity transfer and re-affirming accuracy in the annual report data. Failure to maintain current UBO records results in SAMR correction orders and holds on subsequent registration formalities.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Senior Management (高级管理人员名册)
Minute Book (shareholders' meetings and board resolutions)
Register of Share Transfers and Capital Contribution Records
Corporate Seal Usage Log and custody ledger

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500–2,500 per annum for a compliant registered office address (city-dependent; premium Shanghai/Beijing addresses at the upper bound); USD 400–1,500 per annum for local corporate agency/secretarial services; typical combined range USD 900–4,000.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,000–4,500 per annum for a standard statutory audit of a small-to-mid WFOE (ISIC 7490 professional services); consolidated group audit mandates or extended CIT reconciliation support increase the range to USD 4,000–8,000.
